documents.title: 1960 Presidential Elections in the Republic of Korea
documents.notes: CIC military-vote plan; police, teachers and village chiefs in re-elections; open/team voting; administration and Liberal Party pressure.

documents.title: Telegram 719, Embassy Seoul to Department of State
documents.notes: Rhee ordered Home Minister to arrest lawbreakers and stop imitation ballots; National Police Director Yi Kang-hak warning; military police traffic-control substitution.

documents.title: Telegram 732, Embassy Seoul to Department of State
documents.notes: Masan unrest, casualties reported, military-force request; later report ties demonstration to opposition withdrawal over election abuses.

documents.title: Memorandum of Conversation: Korean Elections
documents.notes: U.S. concern over violence and irregularities communicated to Korean Ambassador Yang You-chan.

documents.title: Department telegram 816 to Embassy Seoul
documents.notes: U.S. assessment of Masan protests as resentment over election abuses; cautions against labeling dissatisfaction communist-inspired.

documents.title: Eisenhower-Herter telephone conversation
documents.notes: U.S. leadership attributes crisis to election conduct and suppression of critics; discusses new election pressure.

documents.title: Editorial Note: Chang resignation and Rhee cabinet response
documents.notes: Chang Myon resignation; Rhee accepts cabinet resignations and announces withdrawal from partisan politics.

reviewHistory.reason: FRUS d305 heading is Editorial Note, not original contemporaneous document; primary count correction
